blend: Smooth interpolation using actual dimension daylight factor; radial falloff relative to event center; fade in 2s and out 5s.
distance_rule: Sky tint and fog tint must both fade to vanilla across effect_radius..effect_radius+falloff. Do not globally recolor other dimensions or players.
panorama_rule: Use horizon-only red cloud bands at modest opacity, keep native celestial sprites separate. Cubemap stars must not be doubled by native star rendering.
lighting: Do not rewrite world block lighting or game time merely to tint sky. Optional full-screen grade is weak and must not erase vanilla block textures.
